items.description:
CES Forklift is the official importer and distributor of Liugong forklifts and material handlers in South Africa. Its range covers diesel, electric, rough-terrain and 4x4 forklifts, with a variety of models and powerplants for different applications and terrains. Beyond supplying the machines, the company provides operator training and licensing, technical support and fast on-site field service.

Liugong has a proven track record in South Africa, with thousands of machines in operation across the country. CES Forklift gives customers access to parts and speedy resolution of distribution and warranty claims, and its head office is in Montague Gardens, Cape Town, where the team presents itself as a business partner focused on productivity.

False Bay Vet is a small animal clinic in Muizenberg that cares for pets as well as wildlife. Its services include wellness exams that check on each animal's health and wellbeing, surgical procedures carried out with care and precision, and nutrition and parasite advice for pets and the families who live with them.

The clinic places as much weight on sustainability and community education as on treatment, built on the strong bond between humans, animals and the environment. For after-hours emergencies, pet owners are referred to The Animal Hospital in Rosmead, so the practice is clear about where to turn when it is closed. It suits owners in Muizenberg and the wider False Bay area who want compassionate, everyday care for their animals close to home.

Makemba Boutique is a bohemian designer label based at Imhoff Farm in Kommetjie, selling limited-edition jewellery, clothing and accessories. Its silver and brass jewellery is inspired by tribal art and craftsmanship, and the leather pieces are handmade by a Zimbabwean artisan. Hand-made macrame pieces complete the jewellery range, and the name comes from a central African word meaning freedom.

The clothing is made from natural fibres, including Indian hand-loomed cottons, West African mudcloth and hand block prints, and it caters to slow-fashion shoppers who appreciate ancient textile skills. The boutique has moved into a new space at Imhoff Farm on Kommetjie Road, among the farm's restaurants and artisan studios, which makes it a good stop for anyone looking for something unusual rather than mass-market fashion.

Queen's Hair & Beauty is a hair and beauty salon founded in 2019, with its Cape Town CBD branch in Shop 46 at Golden Acre on Adderley Street. The salon offers lace front and full lace wig installation, bespoke wig making from 100% human hair, and a supply line of premium wigs, bundles and closures. Makeup services cover glam, soft glam and bridal looks, while nail care includes manicures, pedicures and long-wear gel finishes.

Every appointment begins with a personal consultation, and clients can enquire about any service directly through WhatsApp. The business describes itself as a premium hair and beauty destination with seven branches across South Africa, five of them in Cape Town and two in the Eastern Cape, so it suits clients who want a polished, carefully finished look for everyday wear or a special occasion.

Ital Cement is a family-run manufacturer of precast cement products and garden features, operating from its factory in Northgate Estate, Ysterplaat. The range includes fountains, birdbaths, pots, tables and benches, balusters and wall copings, basins, lanterns, fireplace surrounds and pizza ovens, and the company also develops custom products for clients across different industries.

The business says it brought the craft of cement precast mouldings from Italy to South Africa, and it has supplied nurseries, landscapers, builders and the end user for more than 25 years. Customers can visit the factory to browse the products, and a delivery service runs within 30km of the Cape Town factory, with longer distances quoted by load and distance. It suits anyone looking for well-made garden pieces in the Cape Town area.

Sakura is an Asian restaurant at 48 Second Avenue in Harfield Village, Claremont, known for its sushi and for traditional dishes that the chefs prepare from their homeland recipes. The menu also includes dim sums, spring rolls, chop suey and a range of fried rice dishes.

The wine list offers a range of choices at decent prices, and foreign beers are on offer as well. The décor is simple and comfortable, and the atmosphere is described as lovely. Prices are available on request, so diners who want to plan their budget can ask the restaurant directly before they visit.

Carlyle's on Derry is an Italian restaurant and bar in Vredehoek, known locally for its wood-fired pizzas alongside a broader Italian menu. The business is also classified as a pizza delivery outlet, and keeps separate telephone lines for sit-down dining and takeaway orders, with table bookings taken through the Dineplan online reservation system.

The restaurant trades every day of the week, open continuously from midday until eleven at night, which makes it a dependable option for both a relaxed lunch and a late dinner. Located on Derry Street in Vredehoek, it draws diners from across the City Bowl who are after pizza, pasta and other Italian dishes, whether for a sit-down meal, a takeaway order or home delivery.

Clicks Cape Quarter is a pharmacy, health, beauty and personal-care retailer trading inside the Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village in De Waterkant. The branch's own listing on the Clicks website separates the general retail store from its in-house pharmacy, each with its own contact number, pointing to a dedicated dispensary operating alongside the usual Clicks shopping floor of skincare, cosmetics, haircare and everyday health products.

As part of the national Clicks chain, the store also gives customers access to ClubCard rewards and the wider range of pharmacy services the brand is known for. Trading from Shop 12 & 13 at 27 Somerset Road, it is a convenient stop for residents, office workers and visitors moving through De Waterkant and the surrounding Cape Town CBD and Green Point area.

items.description:
Clicks Prospur Pharmacy is a Clicks branch trading from the Prospur Shopping Centre in Plumstead, combining a full pharmacy with the chain's usual health, beauty and personal-care retail range. The branch is listed individually on the Clicks website with its own pharmacy contact line, separate from the general store number, pointing to a proper dispensary rather than just a retail counter.

Shoppers can use the pharmacy for dispensing and everyday health advice while browsing the wider Clicks range of skincare, cosmetics, baby care and household items. Trading from 76 Churchill Road, the branch serves residents and shoppers across Plumstead and the surrounding southern suburbs who want pharmacy and retail health services under one roof.

Clicks at Waterstone Village is a pharmacy and health, beauty and personal-care store trading from Shop 12 inside the Waterstone Village shopping centre in Somerset West. The centre's own store directory lists the branch individually, alongside its own direct contact number, distinguishing it from the many other specialist retailers and services operating in the same centre.

As part of the national Clicks chain, the store carries the familiar range of skincare, cosmetics, baby care, household essentials and in-store pharmacy services. Waterstone Village sits at the corner of the R44 and Main Road, giving easy access to shoppers and households across Somerset West and the wider Helderberg area who are doing a pharmacy or retail health run.

Col'Cacchio Canal Walk is a halaal-certified Italian restaurant inside Canal Walk Shopping Centre in Century City, part of the long-running Col'Cacchio pizza chain. The menu is built around gourmet wood-fired pizzas alongside pasta and salads, with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options available for diners with specific dietary needs.

The brand's own restaurant locator lists the Canal Walk branch individually, with its own telephone number and trading hours separate from other Col'Cacchio restaurants in Cape Town, pointing to a full sit-down operation rather than a kiosk-style outlet. Trading from Shop 167 in Canal Walk, it serves shoppers, Century City residents and families looking for halaal Italian dining, whether for a quick lunch or a sit-down dinner.

items.description:
Dr V H Davids is a dental practice operating from Shop 6 in the Bonteheuwel Town Centre on Kiaat Road. The practice is listed on the Medpages healthcare directory as a registered dental provider, alongside other general practitioners, nurses and specialists in the area, though the directory itself notes that it is still in the process of updating and verifying this particular provider's full details.

As a neighbourhood dental practice, it offers an accessible option for patients who would otherwise have to travel further for dental care. Based in the heart of Bonteheuwel, the practice serves patients from Bonteheuwel and the surrounding communities who are looking for a local dentist close to home, inside the town centre where other everyday shops and services are also based.

Factory Toy Shop is a toy retailer trading from Voortrekker Road in Parow, listed on business directories specifically as a toy shop and toy supplier rather than a general variety store. That classification points to a shop built around toys and games as its core business, stocking options for boys and girls, educational toys and board games alongside other children's toys.

It gives parents, grandparents and gift-buyers a dedicated toy destination rather than having to search through the toy aisle of a bigger retailer. Trading from 250 Voortrekker Road in Parow, the shop serves families across Parow and the surrounding northern suburbs who are shopping for birthdays, Christmas or everyday play, and want a focused range of toys for children of different ages.

items.description:
Going Under Clothing is a South African clothing retailer offering affordable, on-trend fashion, with a branch trading from Induland Avenue in Lansdowne. The brand's own store-finder confirms the Lansdowne branch as one of its listed locations, complete with its own trading hours, which sets it apart from the chain's general online policies on lay-bye and returns that apply across all its stores.

Shoppers can expect the same everyday, budget-friendly clothing range the Going Under name is known for, aimed at keeping up with current trends without the price tag of higher-end fashion retailers. Based at 5 Induland Avenue, the branch serves shoppers and households across Lansdowne and the surrounding communities who are after affordable, everyday fashion close to home.

items.description:
Harbour House is a fine-dining seafood restaurant in Kalk Bay Harbour, specialising in fresh fish and seafood prepared with classic French technique and influences drawn from Mediterranean and international cooking. The restaurant's own information places it right at the water's edge of the harbour, with views over the working fishing harbour, False Bay and the Hottentots Holland mountain range beyond.

Beyond everyday dining, the restaurant caters for corporate functions, tour groups and wedding receptions, making it a venue for both a relaxed meal and a larger occasion. Set in Kalk Bay Harbour, it draws local diners, tourists exploring the Kalk Bay waterfront and groups looking for a seafood meal with a view, whether for lunch, dinner or a special celebration.

items.description:
Ho Ho Takeaways is a Chinese takeaway inside the IPIC Shopping Centre in Kenridge, Durbanville, preparing chicken, pork and beef dishes with vegetables, noodles or rice. The menu covers familiar Chinese takeaway styles including sweet-and-sour, stir-fried, cashew, oyster, black-bean, pineapple and curry preparations, plus Foo Yong, giving customers a wide spread of options beyond a standard fixed menu.

The takeaway trades through the afternoon and evening on Mondays, then keeps longer hours from midday through to the evening from Tuesday to Sunday. Based at Shop 10 in the IPIC Shopping Centre on Door De Kraal Avenue, it serves local customers across Kenridge and Durbanville who are after a Chinese takeaway meal to enjoy at home.

Hout Bay Handiman Centre is a hardware store on Victoria Avenue in Hout Bay, listed on business directories under several specific categories: hardware store, building materials store, do-it-yourself shop and paint store. That combination points to a broad hardware operation rather than a narrow specialist outlet, stocking general building, electrical, plumbing and paint supplies for everyday jobs and bigger projects alike.

It is the kind of store where a tradesperson can pick up materials for a job and a homeowner can find what's needed for a weekend DIY project under the same roof. Trading from 44 Victoria Avenue, the centre serves DIY customers, homeowners and local tradespeople across Hout Bay who need hardware and building supplies close to home.

Hungry Lion is a South African fast-food chain known for its fried chicken, and its Delft Mall branch serves the full range of chicken meals, chips, burgers, family meals and buckets found across the brand. The chain's own store locator lists the Delft branch individually, with its own telephone number and map coordinates, confirming it as a standalone, trading outlet inside the mall rather than just a listing on a chain-wide menu page.

Shop 14 in Delft Mall on Hindle Road puts the outlet within easy reach of shoppers moving through the mall. It serves local Delft residents, shoppers and anyone after a quick, affordable chicken meal, whether eating in, taking away or ordering through a delivery partner.

items.description:
PEP is a national value retailer selling affordable clothing, footwear, homeware and cellular products for men, women, children and the whole family, trading on everyday low prices backed by regular in-store catalogues and promotions.

The Bishop Lavis branch operates from Shops 13 to 15 in The Business Centre on League Road, with its own branch contact line for shoppers checking stock or trading times. It keeps extended hours for a value retailer: open from 08:30 to 17:30 Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 15:00 on Saturdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Sundays, making it easy to fit a visit around a working week or weekend outing.

Trading from The Business Centre in Bishop Lavis, the branch serves local households and shoppers looking for budget-friendly basics and seasonal promotions close to home.
